objective: Fit Weibull parametric and Cox PH baselines on the survival table; run proportional-hazards assumption test; record fallback to Weibull AFT when PH fails. Deterministic seeds.
expected_output: test/product/test_models.py (fixture-based; asserts shape/scale finite, PH result structure, fallback branch)
acceptance_criteria: Weibull shape/scale finite and reproducible across runs with fixed seed
check_ph returns per-covariate p-values and a boolean verdict
select_model returns 'cox' or 'weibull_aft' with recorded reason
